🛒 Most lost sales leak at the shopping cart, not at payment: only ~1 in 4 carts convert within an hour, and the rest mostly stall for 1-7 days before fizzling out (just 1-19% of those convert) — payment itself works fine once an order is actually placed (97.6% succeed instantly).
🔁 Most first-time buyers do come back: 40-62% of new customers place a second order within 90 days, typically within 1-2.5 months — a healthy, stable repeat-purchase baseline across the last 3 years.

📦 A return modestly cools the relationship but doesn't end it: customers with a returned order come back 49.7% of the time within 90 days, vs 57.7% for customers with no return — about an 8-point dip, not a cliff.
